sources.title: Toast 1 — Mixedbread's search model runs the… | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Toast 1 is Mixedbread's search model that takes over the whole retrieval loop — splitting a question into subqueries, gathering evidence, then curating context. Mixedbread says it matches Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on search quality.

sources.title: Models - Mixedbread
sources.snippet: The context window includes input messages, tool definitions, tool results, and generated output. Use max_output_tokens with the Responses API or max_completion_tokens with Chat Completions to limit generated output. The Responses API and Chat Completions default to toast-1 when model is omitted.

sources.title: Toast 1 | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Toast 1 is a specialized search agent that decomposes a query into subqueries, executes multi round tool calls to search document collections, inspects sources, and curates relevant evidence before returning it. It can run standalone or as a subagent within a frontier language model, and works with Mixedbread Search or any existing retrieval backend.
